subject: AWS ACE onboarding & PDM/PSM intro — StratusRetail opportunity
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Porter <jane.porter@amazon.com>, Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@stratusretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS ACE onboarding & quick PDM/PSM intro for StratusRetail

Hi Jane / Sam,

Thanks again for the time last week — StratusRetail is ramping quickly and they want to move the integration and procurement cadence forward before the new year. We discussed pursuing an ACE co-sell path with AWS; I wanted to kick off formal ACE registration and introduce our internal PDM/PSM leads so we can align on a mutual action plan.

Quick asks:
- Jane: can you confirm the ACE intake link and whether we should include a primary AWS PDM in the intake (I can populate the form if you send the right portal URL)?
- Sam: can you confirm the scope (initial pilot: 3x GPU nodes, private VPC, expected 50k tokens/day) and the key stakeholders you want on the PDM/PSM intro?

I've attached an ACE registration form prefilled with what we have and a starter MAP. Karthik, looping you to coordinate the technical handoff and to be present on the PDM conversation.

Proposed next steps (short list):
1) Jane confirms ACE intake link and PDM point-of-contact from AWS.
2) Sam confirms stakeholders + preferred time for a 30-min intro call next week.
3) We submit ACE registration and share the MAP back to AWS.

Thanks — sending availability for next Tue/Wed in a follow-up.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: ACE_Registration_Form_StratusRetail.pdf; Mutual_Action_Plan_Stratus_2026-12.xlsx
From: Jane Porter <jane.porter@amazon.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@stratusretail.com>
Cc: Lina Morales <lina.morales@stratusretail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: AWS ACE onboarding & quick PDM/PSM intro for StratusRetail

Hi Ava / Sam,

Thanks for the note. Confirming next steps from the AWS side: please use the ACE portal (https://aws.amazon.com/partner/ace/intake) — I'll be the intake reviewer for this region. We do prefer the intake to include explicit pilot sizing, expected go-live window, and mention of any procurement timing if you have it.

For PDM/PSM coverage: our PDM for retail verticals is Marco Reyes (marco.reyes@amazon.com) — I can loop him into the introduction. PSM coverage will be assigned after intake approval, but I'll flag the request for a short pre-approval sync.

I've added Lina (StratusRetail ops) to keep procurement visibility. Happy to host a 30-min intro Wed 12/23 at 11am PT if that works for your team.

Jane
Enterprise Partner Manager, AWS
jane.porter@amazon.com | +1 (206) 555-0142

Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 12:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS ACE onboarding & quick PDM/PSM intro for StratusRetail — confirm Wed 11am PT

Jane / Marco / Sam — thanks for the quick reply and for offering Marco. Wed 12/23 11:00am PT works for our crew. I've put Karthik and Soojin on the intro so we can cover technical constraints and deployment timelines during the call. Priyom, please join to capture procurement asks and to confirm our license/commercial readiness.

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m intros & roles
- 10m pilot scope & architecture (Karthik + Sam)
- 10m ACE intake ask & procurement timeline (Priyom + Lina)
- 5m next steps & MAP ownership

Prep items:
- Sam: confirm pilot window (target Jan 10-17) and procurement contact (Lina is cc'd).
- Karthik: bring short list of sequence length and latency SLOs.
- Priyom: confirm expected billing cadence and whether a PO will be provided or if this moves via marketplace ordering.

I've attached the slightly updated MAP with responsibilities. If anyone needs a calendar update or a different time, flag now and I'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Ava

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Stratus_2026-12.xlsx
From: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@stratusretail.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Jane Porter <jane.porter@amazon.com>, Marco Reyes <marco.reyes@amazon.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS ACE onboarding & quick PDM/PSM intro for StratusRetail — confirm Wed 11am PT

Thanks everyone — Wed 11am PT is good. A couple clarifications from our side before the call:

- Pilot window: aiming for Jan 12 start, 4-week pilot.
- Procurement: Lina will confirm whether we'll issue a PO or use marketplace ordering during the call — Lina, can you confirm?
- Security/compliance: we have a short SOC2 evidence request that we'll send after intake; can Redwood share the SOC2 checklist in advance?

Looking forward to the sync — I think aligning on MAP ownership in that call will help accelerate the ACE approval.

Cheers,
Sam Ortega
Head of Platform Engineering
StratusRetail
sam.ortega@stratusretail.com | +1 (312) 555-0103
